paragraphs.text: 1. FOR life I set thee free by this oblation from the unknown decline and from Consumption;
paragraphs.original: मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात् ।
paragraphs.translit: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kamajñātayakṣmāduta rājayakṣmāt |

paragraphs.text: Or, if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni.
paragraphs.original: ग्राहिर्जग्राह यदि वैतदेनं तस्या इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनम्
paragraphs.translit: grāhirjagrāha yadi vaitadenaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktamenam

paragraphs.text: 2. Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already,
paragraphs.original: यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरन्तिकं नीत एव ।
paragraphs.translit: yadi kṣitāyuryadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyorantikaṃ nīta eva |

paragraphs.text: Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.
3. With hundred-eyed oblation, hundred-autumned, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him,
That Indra for a hundred years may lead him safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.
paragraphs.original: शतं यथेमं शरदो नयातीन्द्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम्
paragraphs.translit: śataṃ yathemaṃ śarado nayātīndro viśvasya duritasya pāram

paragraphs.text: 4. Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters.
paragraphs.original: शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्ताञ्छतमु वसन्तान् ।
paragraphs.translit: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantāñchatamu vasantān |

paragraphs.text: Through hundred-lived oblation Indra, Agni, Brhaspati, Savitar yield him for a hundred!
paragraphs.original: शतमिन्द्राग्नी सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषेमं पुनर्दुः
paragraphs.translit: śatamindrāgnī savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣemaṃ punarduḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. So have I found and rescued thee thou hast returned with youth renewed.
Whole in thy members! I have found thy sight and all thy life for thee.
paragraphs.original: सर्वाङ्ग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वमायुश्च तेऽविदम्
paragraphs.translit: sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvamāyuśca te'vidam
